Where your numbers create memorable guest experiences. Are you detail-oriented, driven, and ready to take the next step in your finance career? Our hotel is looking for an Accounts Supervisor to lead daily financial operations and support our commitment to excellence.

Open the door to a great stay and endless possibilities at Staybridge Suites Doha Lusail. Strategically located just 10 minutes from downtown Doha, a 30-minute drive from Hamad International Airport, Staybridge Suites Doha Lusail offers modern serviced apartments for guests looking for a home away from home in Qatar. Stylishly designed and furnished with thoughtful amenities for short or extended stays, each serviced apartment is fitted with separate bedrooms, a living area, a full kitchen, a laundry machine and a workspace for the perfect blend of work, relax, and play. A collection of one, two- and three-bedroom apartments are available for single professionals or families looking to stay in the rapidly developing business district of Lusail. Maintain your workout regimen in the fully equipped Fitness Centre, or take a dip in the swimming pool. Grab your essentials at The Pantry, a 24-hour convenience store. Complimentary Wi-Fi internet access is available for guests to work and stay connected. Discover what Doha has to offer with famous attractions such as the historic Lusail Stadium, Souq Waqif, Katara Cultural Village, Corniche, The Pearl, Westbay, Lagoona Mall and Place Vendome Mall with just a 10–15-minute drive away.
q: At least 2 years hotel accounting experience preferred.
Strong understanding of hospitality systems (Opera, Micros, SunSystems, etc.).

We all know there’s no place like home. But why should that stop us from creating elevated suites and community for both short and extended stay guests? At Staybridge Suites®, guests can enjoy a free, hot breakfast; complimentary evening social hour with appetizers three nights a week; and a friendly chat with new friends around the outdoor firepit. In over 300+ hotels globally, our inviting spaces offer a greater sense of community and thoughtful service that give guests the freedom to relax, work, and play. Just like our colleagues. We’ll help you create the warmest welcome. Whether you’re preparing a suite exactly as your guest wants it, hosting The Social, or just knowing guests by their name, rather than their room number. Your big-hearted personality will help guests feel free to be themselves.

r: You will be at the heart of our financial success—ensuring accuracy, integrity, and seamless financial processes across the hotel.
Oversee daily accounting tasks including AR, AP, general ledger, and reconciliations.
Review daily revenue reports and ensure accuracy across all hotel outlets.
Supervise Income Audit activities and ensure strong internal controls.
Manage supplier payments, reconciliations, and credit collections.
Support payroll review and monthly financial reporting.
Lead, train, and support a small accounting team.
Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and audit preparation.

We are currently seeking a passionate, proactive, and dynamic Environmental Health & Safety professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of occupational health and safety, food safety, environmental protection, and sustainability throughout the hotel.
p

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the effective implementation and continuous improvement of the hotel's Environmental Health & Safety Management Systems (EHSMS), in compliance with HACCP principles, relevant ISO standards, Occupational Health & Safety Management Systems (OHSMS), and all applicable local and international regulations.
q: A college or university degree in Health and Safety, Food Safety, Environmental Science, Sustainability, or a related discipline is required. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 2–3 years of relevant experience in an EHS, Food Safety, or Sustainability role, preferably within the hospitality industry or a similar high-risk operational environment.
Relevant professional certifications will be considered an advantage, including NEBOSH, IOSH, ISO 22000, ISO 45001, HACCP, and Lead Auditor qualifications.
The candidate must be computer literate and possess excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Arabic.

The ideal candidate will be customer-focused, highly proactive, and results-oriented, with an outgoing, approachable, and engaging personality. They should demonstrate strong initiative, attention to detail, and the ability to identify potential risks and implement effective solutions.

The candidate must be able to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment and demonstrate strong teamwork skills, particularly when working with a diverse, multicultural workforce and interacting with guests.
The successful candidate should also possess the following competencies:
r: Establish, implement, monitor, and continually improve the hotel's EHS and Food Safety Management Systems in accordance with HACCP, applicable ISO standards, and regulatory requirements.
Provide regular reports to management on EHS and food safety performance, highlighting key findings, areas of concern, and recommendations for improvement.
Plan, coordinate, and participate in EHS, HACCP, ISO, sustainability, and OHSMS audits, ensuring compliance and timely implementation of corrective actions.
Develop and maintain comprehensive audit programs covering food safety, occupational health and safety, and environmental management.
Monitor audit results, analyze performance trends, communicate findings, and coordinate action plans to ensure compliance with corporate and statutory requirements.
Investigate accidents, incidents, and near misses, identify root causes, and implement appropriate corrective and preventive measures.
Keep abreast of changes in health, safety, environmental, and food safety legislation, ensuring that relevant policies, procedures, and documentation are updated accordingly.
Drive continuous improvement through the monitoring, analysis, and reporting of EHS performance indicators, objectives, and targets.
Coordinate with the Hotel EHS Committee to review performance, monitor action plans, and achieve established objectives.
Develop and deliver EHS and food safety training programs to ensure employees are aware of their responsibilities and comply with established standards.
Conduct regular workplace inspections and follow up on identified hazards and corrective actions to ensure timely resolution.
Monitor suppliers and contractors to ensure compliance with the hotel's EHS and food safety requirements through regular audits and communication.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date EHSMS and food safety documentation, including policies, procedures, manuals, inspection records, and reports.
Work closely with hotel departments to develop and implement Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and sustainability initiatives.
Coordinate and oversee the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of Rotana Earth programs within the hotel.
Promote a strong culture of safety, environmental awareness, and responsible work practices to protect employees, guests, contractors, and the environment.
Ensure consistent compliance with all hotel policies, procedures, and standards relating to environmental protection, occupational health and safety, and food safety.
Develop, implement, maintain, and periodically review OHSMS manuals, policies, procedures, and related documentation.
Lead the implementation and ongoing effectiveness of the Occupational Health & Safety Management System through regular inspections, internal audits, committee meetings, and management reviews.
Support department heads in establishing, implementing, and achieving departmental EHS objectives and performance targets.
Ensure all new employees receive appropriate occupational health and safety induction and job-specific training.
Prepare and submit OHSMS performance reports to senior management and relevant regulatory authorities, as required.
Identify applicable legal and regulatory requirements and ensure they are effectively communicated and implemented across all hotel departments.
Plan and conduct occupational health and safety audits and inspections to assess compliance with applicable legislation, standards, and hotel procedures.
Communicate audit findings to relevant departments and monitor the implementation and effectiveness of corrective action plans
